user.title: Connect your NIO vehicle
user.description: Sniff one vehicle-status request from the NIO app (MITM proxy: icar.nio.com/api/2/rvs/vehicle/.../status) and paste the whole request URL below, plus its Authorization Bearer token. The URL is replayed exactly as captured — don't edit it; the server's signature covers the entire query.

data.capture: Captured status request URL (the whole .../status?... line)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate NIO
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a fresh Bearer token. If the signature was rejected (e.g. the NIO app updated), also paste a newly captured status request URL to refresh it.

data.capture: Captured status request URL (optional — only if re-sniffed)

error.invalid_auth: The NIO API rejected the token. Re-sniff a fresh Bearer token.
error.invalid_sign: The NIO API rejected the signature, not the token — the captured request no longer matches (the app likely updated). Re-sniff a current status request and paste the whole URL.
error.invalid_url: Couldn't parse that as a status request. Paste the whole line containing /vehicle/.../status?...&sign=...
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the NIO API.

intervals.title: Polling cadence
intervals.description: Polling the private API too aggressively can get the token rate-limited or invalidated.

credentials.title: Update credentials
credentials.description: Paste a fresh Bearer token. To refresh the captured request too (e.g. after a NIO app update), also paste a newly captured status request URL.

data.capture: Captured status request URL (optional — only if re-sniffed)

error.invalid_auth: The NIO API rejected the token. Re-sniff a fresh Bearer token.
error.invalid_sign: The NIO API rejected the signature, not the token — the captured request no longer matches (the app likely updated). Re-sniff a current status request and paste the whole URL.
error.invalid_url: Couldn't parse that as a status request. Paste the whole line containing /vehicle/.../status?...&sign=...
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the NIO API.
